Beyond the Research

Arts & Crafts

“I do not want art for a few, any more than education for a few, or freedom for a few.” William Morris, ‘The Decorative Arts’ lecture to the Trades’ Guild of Learning, 4th December 1877

Asides from publishing on the (positive and negative) wellbeing impacts of craft participation, beyond my academic work I am also a passionate hobbyist in pottery, print-making, sewing, knitting/crochet, and analogue photography.

In particular, I started teaching myself pottery as part of my research with potters and have kept up with my practice since. Here are some pics of some of my latest projects.

I'm always excited to connect with other crafty academics and students, and am keen to continue exploring research ideas that combine creative research methods, craft community participation, and the role of the handmade in the digital age.
